name: January network shock: auto-moved members + 'still open until Jan 15' (EN/ES)
demand_trigger: Cigna/Molina/Sunshine members who did nothing get re-enrolled by HealthCare.gov with a DIFFERENT company (45 CFR 155.335(j)(3)); they discover it Jan 1-15 when a doctor/pharmacy says 'not in network' - while Open Enrollment is still open until Jan 15
content_concept: 'I was moved to a new health plan in January' EN/ES pages + live 'Is enrollment still open?' page; WhatsApp share card 'Te cambiaron de seguro? Todavía puedes escoger hasta el 15 de enero'; Bubba IG story Jan 2-14
offer_cta: Moved to a plan you didn't pick? You can still choose your own until Jan 15 (free, 60 seconds).
hypothesis: Members auto-moved to an issuer they didn't choose hit a network surprise in the first two weeks of January, while they can still switch. Nobody publishes for that moment (competitor pages stop at Dec 15). Expect the highest phone-step completion of any test because the problem is concrete and has a 2-week clock. Window may run past Jan 15: HealthCare.gov lists a discontinued Marketplace plan as an SEP reason (60 days after Dec 31 = ~Mar 1); read primary results on Jan 15, secondary on Mar 1.

hypothesis: The same public layoff signal that produces health leads also produces life leads, because group life ends with the job and has a 31-day deadline nobody explains. Doubles revenue per layoff event at zero extra acquisition cost.
